positions.name: DeriveIdFallbackAcceptanceCriteria
positions.frame: what must the derive-id E2E test establish about the missing-id fallback path — the failure it reproduces and the behavior it demands?
positions.why: src-1 names the specific production failure pattern being reproduced (## heading, no id field) and src-2 states the non-negotiable requirements the fix must satisfy (no crash, valid slug) — read together they describe one test's acceptance criteria: the reproduction sets up the failure condition, the directive sets the bar the fallback must clear. The dimensional reads support this: both carry authority-ranking relational stance and competence-value framing, though src-1 sits at plain-assertion/claim conviction while src-2 sits at commitment/decision — a gradient worth noting rather than resolving, since the pair spans description-of-problem to demand-on-solution within the same test case.
